# Disruption with some GitHub services

## What Changed

Nov 19, 18:17 UTC Resolved - Between November 5, 2026, at 18:02 UTC and November 19, 2026, at 18:05 UTC, GitHub users experienced unexpected expiration of their web browser sessions despite continued activity, requiring them to login. An authentication change introduced an issue that caused web requests to bypass the session activity updates and cookie renewal that normally extend session lifetime. Affected sessions consequently expired when they reached their initial expiration time. We mitigated the incident by deploying a fix to ensure that continued web activity renews session expiration and browser cookies. We are adding monitoring to detect unexpected drops in session renewal activity, helping us catch similar issues sooner and reduce their impact on users. Nov 19, 18:05 UTC Update - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 19, 17:43 UTC Monitoring - Starting around 18:02 UTC on November 5, GitHub web sessions stopped being renewed based on recent activity, so users were signed out when their sessions expired due to inactivity. These sign-outs were caused by a bug in session renewal, not due to a security incident. We believe we fixed...
